sources.name: Cycling Env
sources.summary: CycEnv: output of the Cycling Envelope Generator; repeatable Rise/Fall/Hold shapes; loops as a complex LFO in Run/Loop mode.
sources.cite: FW5 manual §9.6 pp67–69 (cycling envelope) + §5.2.1 pp36–37 (matrix source row)

sources.name: ENV
sources.summary: ENV: output of the standard Envelope Generator; one ADS pass per gate; attack 0-10s, decay/release 0-13s, sustain held on key.

sources.name: LFO
sources.summary: LFO output; six shapes (sine, triangle, rising saw, square, random, gliding random); 0.06-100 Hz free or clock-synced 8/1..1/32.

sources.name: Pressure/Vel
sources.summary: PRESS row (the manual spells it PRESSURE; the panel says PRESS): keybed pressure or velocity per Utility>Preset>Press mode; capacitive, ~30% from finger skin up to 100% with harder contact. The routing lives in the preset's edit buffer, so a preset change drops it.
sources.cite: FW5 manual §5.2.1 pp36–37 + §10.2 p72 (fingertip ≈30% of the pressure range)

sources.name: Key/Arp/Seq
sources.summary: KEY/ARP: combined output of keyboard, arpeggiator and sequencer; drives pitch-position and pattern-step modulation.
sources.cite: FW5 manual §5.2.1 pp36–37 + §13.2 p92 (sequencer modulation tracks)

destinations.name: Pitch
destinations.summary: Oscillator pitch; adds to the hardwired 1V/oct. Key/Arp to Pitch doubles or triples step intervals; negative values shrink them to microtonal.

destinations.name: Wave
destinations.summary: Oscillator primary macro; engine-dependent: table select (Wavetable/WaveUser), sample start (Sample/Cloud Grains), waveform elsewhere.

destinations.name: Timbre
destinations.summary: Oscillator tone macro; engine-dependent: cycle scan (Wavetable), grain density (Scan/Cloud/Hit Grains), FM amount (Two Op. FM).

destinations.name: Cutoff
destinations.summary: Analog 12 dB/oct state-variable filter cutoff (~30 Hz to >15 kHz); hardwired to the envelope via Filter Amt, also a matrix destination.

destinations.name: Assign1/2/3
destinations.summary: Three user-assignable destinations: Glide, Osc Type, Sample, Filter Resonance, Env stages, LFO/Arp rate, CycEnv stages, Matrix Amount.
destinations.cite: FW5 manual §5.2.2 p38 (assigning destinations) + §16.3 p120 (unison spread as a target)

recipes.hint: CycEnv mode Loop or Env; small amount; slow rise/fall
recipes.result: Wavesequencing / table-position motion; evolving timbre that never settles.
recipes.engine_note: Wave = table select on Wavetable/WaveUser; sample start on Sample/Cloud Grains.

recipes.result: Per-note timbre bloom; engine-dependent cycle scan / grain density / FM amount.
recipes.engine_note: Timbre = cycle scan (Wavetable), grain density (Scan/Cloud/Hit Grains), FM amount (Two Op. FM).

recipes.result: Classic per-note filter sweep: the note speaks, then closes.
Sudden pitch rise then slow fall: a note-attack chirp.
Note-triggered wave or table jump on each key.
recipes.engine_note: Manual names envelopes as Type modulators, not Wave, so keep this one small.

recipes.hint: Triangle or slow sine; modest amount
recipes.result: Standard filter sweep; add a little random for a fuzzy edge.
Automatic transpositions or random pitch drift across a sequence.
Expressive brightness that opens as you press harder.

recipes.hint: Assign target = Cycling Env Rise or Fall
recipes.result: Finger controls envelope rise/fall times; negative-going shortens the fall.

recipes.hint: Route on top of the hardwired 1V/oct; try +/-
recipes.result: Changes sequence step scope: 2-4 semitones, or microtonal when negative.
Pattern-driven engine jumps per step or per note.

unknowns.question: Does incoming MIDI channel aftertouch feed the matrix Pressure source on FW5?
unknowns.why: Manual documents keybed pressure/velocity only; a forum report is suggestive but not authoritative.

unknowns.question: How deep is one CC step of modulation as heard (the stair-step question)?
unknowns.why: No per-step resolution is documented; a forum thread reports audible stair-steps on CC#23 and on pressure routing.

unknowns.question: What is the value curve of a matrix amount into each destination's parameter range?
unknowns.why: Amount is documented as bipolar -100%..+100%, but the amount-to-parameter mapping is not published.

unknowns.question: How smoothed is internal matrix modulation versus external CC?
unknowns.why: Reports say internal is smoother than fast CC, but no slew or latency figure is documented.
